setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays one trig on step 1: root C (MIDI 60, C3) at velocity 50, held for 4 steps. Chd1 to Chd4 on the Masks page are E, G, A and C (MIDI 64, 67, 69, 72) and the output is polyphonic. Trig params is open on its parameter list, showing Chord Note Strum. No slot is assigned yet, so the five notes would sound together.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press K3 to assign Chord Note Strum to slot 1 and K2 to return. Turn E3 to 1/2. Slot 1 now shows 1/2 with no L or S marker; pause here before moving to another slot.
steps.title: Verify the half-step Strum value

steps.caption: From the half-step Strum slot, turn E2 to the next slot, press K2 and turn E3 to Chord Pattern.
steps.title: Choose the chord pattern slot

steps.caption: Finish the setup the next examples reuse: assign Chord Pattern and turn E3 one detent to -> (forward); Assign Mute Chord Root and leave it at X so the root still sounds; then assign Chord Velocity Mod and turn E3 to +10 (E2 moves to the next slot, K2 opens the list, E3 browses, K3 assigns, K2 returns). Tap Play (1,8), then tap it again to stop. In the MIDI strip the notes arrive one after another, half a step apart: C3 (60), E3 (64), G3 (67), A3 (69) and C4 (72). With Strum at X they would all start together.
steps.title: Hear the strummed chord
